description: Predict how a draft post will perform against the user's historical data. Uses an OLS regression model with detrending, ridge regularization, and recency weighting — the same model used on the /score page. Returns a predicted engagement percentile, projected engagement range, factor breakdown, similar past posts, and improvement suggestions. Free. Pass `profile_id` to scope to a tracked profile, `collection_id` to scope to a collection, or neither to score against the user's full library.

collection_id.description: Optional post_collections.id (scopes the model to this collection)

format.description: Post format: text, image, video, document, article, or poll

profile_id.description: Optional tracked profile ID (scopes the model to this profile's posts)

name: score_draft
title: Score Draft
